name: branding-pyxonlab-expo-booth-mockup-in-electric-blue
title: PyxonLab expo booth mockup: electric blue wall with 'Turn your product into a best selling brand'
whatItIs: A dark exhibition hall with a long booth wall glowing electric blue with ribbed fabric panels, a white headline and service list, the PyxonLab logo on a small screen, a chair and pouf, and a frosted 'EXPO R' sign panel.
whatItMeans: Bold and immersive; one saturated colour fills the space and becomes the brand.
techniques: Flood an environment in a single brand colour.
Use ribbed panels to catch light and add texture.
Keep copy short and uppercase at wall scale.

vocabulary.definition: A branded stand at an exhibition.
